regions.merged_text: Thanks - Mary Wiethoff - 33 - 12 years off and on with very peculiar ache in salivary gland in front of left ear. Enrolled specially for this last Friday. Thing looked and from out side felt like blind cancer. Was advised to promise some little sacrifice if relief came inside of week. In side an hour she phoned " a bone-like piece of calsium " was in her own little pincers, which she easily succeeded in extracting from inside of her jaw. Looks ten yrs. young. To-day ... Febr. 8th, 1948 Same Mary Wiethoff writes " ... No more troubles with said jaw .... " Sends perpetual enrollment for Poor Souls in thanks- giving. $5.00
